name: LAPLACE Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: LAPLACE Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of thermal processes, coatings, and related automated equipment for photovoltaic cell manufacturing in China and internationally. The company offers thermal process equipment used in boron diffusion, phosphorus diffusion, oxidation, and annealing equipment; and coating equipment, including low pressure chemical vapor, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor, atomic layer, and atomic layer edge passivation deposition equipment products.
